verbs.passive.notes: Configured Is spellings and handlers are unchanged. Ordinary Function-value assignment does not declare a new invocation family; a framed native definition in a value position requires a complete noun family. The current CLI builds one standalone App with core Print and Text; this is compiler analysis, not runtime evidence.

verbs.associative.notes: Configured Use spellings and handlers are unchanged. A lexical alias inherits forms only when removing qualification under the unchanged canonical root of a complete validated family. Renames and selected actor aliases declare complete families; alias chains cannot bypass validation. Ordinary value aliases remain data. Dot-qualified authored references, declarations and import aliases reject with source attribution. Text, comments, numbers, paths, native/template contents and internal identities retain their separate meanings and bytes. The current CLI builds one standalone App with core Print and Text; this is compiler analysis, not runtime evidence.

verbs.declarative.notes: Configured Create spellings and handlers are unchanged. Authored source actions and named Functions require complete verb families; native noun declarations require complete noun families. Ordinary value and non-callable application labels remain single names. The current CLI builds one standalone App with core Print and Text; this is compiler analysis, not runtime evidence.

verbs.definitive.notes: Configured Define spellings and handlers are unchanged. Authored noun families require root/plural/descriptive/active and verb families require root/active/passive/applicative/objective, with at least one expanded derived form different from the root case-insensitively. Missing, empty, malformed, surplus or all-identical families reject. Ordinary values remain labels, and native/template bytes retain their separate syntax. The current CLI builds one standalone App with core Print and Text; this is compiler analysis, not runtime evidence.
